utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that. I’ll keep to the usual plan and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll swing by the usual spots and see what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just a quick hand moving the donated gear and keeping an eye on the sign-in table.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is still happening, right? I just want to make sure before I tell anyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still happening — I just want to make sure the timing and drop-off details are clear before we spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — so it’s still on, just waiting for the timing and drop-off details? I’ll hold off telling people until that’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m happy to help, I just need a quick reminder of what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We still need a few basics: screws, duct tape, and at least one good wrench. I’m keeping a list if you want to take one of the runs.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can take the wrench run—just remind me which shop you trust, and I’ll grab the screws too if I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what details should I check first?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—maybe start with the donation drop-off time and whether we still need tools or just supplies.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—I’ll check the drop-off time first, and I’ll ask whether they still need tools or just supplies.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — we’re still gathering the last few items, and the drop-off is going smoothly. If you’ve got anything to add, I can point you to the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great — I’ve got a couple things I can bring by, just point me to the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help, Gus — what do you need done for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I could use a hammer, a screwdriver, and maybe a drill if you’ve got one.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can bring a hammer and screwdriver, and I’ll check if I have a drill too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of where things are headed for the repair drive—what location are we starting with?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — let’s start at the school office, then we can work our way through the neighborhood drop-off spots.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll note the school office as our starting point and keep track of the drop-off spots from there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good turnout already—people’ve been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you want, I can keep an ear out for what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great to hear—thanks, Tess! If you spot anything still needed, let me know and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do, Quinn—I’ll let you know as soon as I hear what they’re short on. Folks are really stepping up today!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have the repair drive details been set yet?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not yet, but I’m checking in with a few people today. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — can you tell me who you’re checking with?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep the plan moving.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate you spreading the word. Let me know if you need anything from me.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll let folks know and keep things moving on the repair drive. I’ll reach out if I need anything from you.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m getting the repair drive organized and I’d love your help. What part can you take on?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the sorting and carrying, if that works. I’ll keep it quiet and do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That works perfectly, Uli — thank you. I’ll put you on sorting and carrying, and I’ll keep it quiet.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive’s getting a good turnout already—folks are really pitching in. If you need the latest, I can keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s good to hear, Tess. Please keep me posted, and let me know if there’s a clear time I should stop by.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as there’s a clear time to stop by.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m probably running a bit late, but I can still help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Dane — could you bring a hammer, some screwdrivers, and a roll of tape? If you’re running late, just come when you can and we’ll make it work.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll grab a hammer, screwdrivers, and tape, then head over as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I’m still sorting the list of things people can bring, and I could use help getting the word out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help spread the word. Want me to post the list where folks in the neighborhood will see it?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m just checking where we should drop everything off and who’s handling the pickup. If you know the location, that’d help me keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m not totally sure on the pickup yet, but I can check the drop-off spot and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — could you double-check the list of items and tell me which ones you can cover?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure — send me the list, and I’ll mark which items I can cover.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I must’ve missed the latest update; what changed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We moved it to Saturday morning and added a small parts table, so folks can grab what they need. I’ll send you the full update if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara — that helps. Please send me the full update so I don’t miss anything else.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet—how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It’s going pretty well so far—folks have been bringing in broken lamps, wobbly chairs, and a few small appliances. If you need a hand, I’ve got tools and can swing by.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great to hear—sounds like a busy day. I might take you up on that if I find anything needing a fix.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help out with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you bring a box cutter, packing tape, and a few markers? If you can, just help sort donations as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’ll bring a box cutter, packing tape, and a few markers, and I’ll help sort the donations as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’m a little worried about the logistics — do we know where folks should drop things off and what time it starts?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, let’s set a clear drop-off spot and start time so it’s easy for everyone. I can help figure that out if you want.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would be great, thanks — once we have the spot and start time, I think people will be much more likely to show up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, I’m putting together the repair drive invites today—want me to add you to the list?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, please add me—I can help keep track of supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll put you down—thanks for helping with supplies!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — thanks, Faye. I was thinking Saturday morning, maybe around 9, but I’m happy to work around the school schedule if that’s better.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 9 should work well for me — I’ll just make sure it doesn’t clash with school drop-off. Thanks for being flexible.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone posted on the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep an ear out for updates and let folks know what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Nell — I’ll send the details as soon as I’ve got them, and I appreciate you helping spread the word.
